# data-sa-058 Statistical analysis text comparison task.

## Task Instructions
Calculate the quartiles and outlier range for each season's data, filtering out the outliers. Then, use the Levene test to compare the rental count variances across the four seasons. Based on the p-value obtained, decide between "Variances are not equal" and "Variances are equal among different seasons". Format your response like this:
```
{ "p-value": [...], "conclusion": [...]
}
```
